generator_protocol.kind: new initial conditions in the same known numerical families; not measured data
generator_protocol.method: contour ETDRK4; 64 fixed upper-half unit-circle roots
generator_protocol.spatial_discretization: Fourier Galerkin, |mode| <= floor(N/3); quadratic 2/3 truncation; cubic product on 2N grid then project
generator_protocol.observation_rule: direct reference-grid subsampling; no interpolated observations
generator_protocol.time_rule: ceil(each observation interval/max_dt) equal substeps, exact output times
generator_protocol.prefix_duration: 0.1 times the unchanged forecast horizon; observations precede forecast start
generator_protocol.seed_rule: SeedSequence([role_seed_base + zero_based_index, family_id]); refinement preserves seed
generator_protocol.initial_amplitude_factor: independent uniform [0.8,1.2), followed by phases uniform [-pi,pi)
generator_protocol.refinement: double reference_N and halve max_dt, same initial Fourier coefficients
generator_protocol.failure_policy: retain source_quality_failure; never replace failed trajectories or relax thresholds
generator_protocol.formal_final_generation: caller must verify global model freeze before requesting final roles

protocol.data_scope: Same three known numerical PDE families, physics, grids and initial-condition distribution. New role seeds148000/148100/148200/148300. No new real measurements. Extend each generated trajectory to 1.1T: history0..0.1T, full future0.1T..1.1T.
protocol.noise: Levels0/.001/.01 times full-grid clean training forecast-segment equal-trajectory RMS. Noise seeds71/103, base159000. Noise added before splitting history/future or subsampling. Only corruption knows clean values and scale.

four_arm_design.weak_resolved: Unchanged weak candidates and raw observed cutoff frame, factor4 forecast.
four_arm_design.denoised_median: Weak candidates plus training-only exact-support medians, filtered cutoff frame, factor4 forecast.
four_arm_design.prefix_weak: Unchanged weak candidates, prefix-aligned average state, factor4 future forecast.
four_arm_design.prefix_median: Weak candidates plus training-only exact-support medians, prefix-aligned average state, factor4 future forecast.

weak_engine_protocol.spatial_tests: nonnegative Fourier modes; real/imaginary rows, nonzero modes sqrt(2) weighted
weak_engine_protocol.temporal_test: (1-z*z)^4 on [-1,1], zero outside; analytic first derivative
weak_engine_protocol.products: 2N zero-padded real trigonometric interpolation; retain selected observed-grid Fourier modes
weak_engine_protocol.quadrature: composite degree-nine Newton-Cotes on original samples, eight subintervals per panel
weak_engine_protocol.selection: unchanged L1 path, normalized OLS debias and development forecast selection

forecast_protocol.factor_selection: fixed before new training/development generation; not family dependent
forecast_protocol.initial_interpolation: real periodic Fourier interpolation of the observed initial frame; scipy.signal.resample handles even-grid Nyquist splitting
forecast_protocol.internal_grid: Nx*factor equally spaced points on the same period, starting at the observed x[0]
forecast_protocol.solver: unchanged pde_discovery.generic_engine.forecast on the internal grid
forecast_protocol.output: direct restriction to every factor-th internal point at the original output times
forecast_protocol.scope: uniform periodic scalar autonomous constant-coefficient nine-term PDE

protocol.development_selection: Medians generated from training only. Original candidates preserved. Prefix augmented pool scored on observed development future, independently select original subset for prefix_weak. RMSE sqrt(mean trajectory MSE); within1.05best+1e-12 choose fewest terms,error,ID. Same prefix predictor in development and final.
protocol.freeze: Method/protocol frozen before new formal training/development. All120 models frozen and hashes verified before9 final trajectories generated. Failures retained, no final selection or tuning.
protocol.final: 360 planned forecasts, 120 models, shared9 final ICs, not360 independent experiments. 11 full or6 coarse history frames ending at forecast cutoff for prefix arms; single-frame controls use same cutoff observation. Clean and noisy future used only for scoring, cutoff frame excluded. Unchanged future horizons AC0.5, Burgers1.5, KS20.
protocol.source_quality: SeparatecalibrationIC doubleNhalfdt, relL2<=1e-5 andmaxabs<=1e-4. Keepfailure, noreplacement/no thresholdchange.

target.metric: maximum across condition means of final-trajectory relative L2; exclude initial frame
target.failure_action: target not achieved; retain failed condition
target.conditioning: observed prefix before forecast start; 11 full or 6 coarse frames

protocol.absolute_prediction_diagnostic: All30 condition means over3 final trajectories <=5%. Report maximum individual and count above5% separately. User approved prefix, not guaranteed all individual forecasts<=5%.
protocol.retrospective_diagnosis: Old fusion KS final ICs extended to22 time units, new predictor tested with fixed old coefficients, future2..22. This development probe is retrospective in initial conditions, not a new holdout.
protocol.limits: 1D uniform periodic scalar autonomous constant-coefficient nine-term library; same known synthetic families with sparse initial spectra. Prefix filtering can remove weak or broadband physical modes. No arbitrary PDE or real-measurement generalization claim.

data_protocol.scale: noise_level * full-grid clean training FORECAST-segment equal-trajectory RMS
data_protocol.sampling_order: full-role noise first, then stride 1 or 2 in space and time
data_protocol.observation_interface: x,t,u,boundary,prefix_t,prefix_u; prefix ends at forecast t[0]; no noise oracle

protocol.median_ablation: prefix_weak versus prefix_median isolates candidate augmentation under same prefix observation/forecast rule.

initial_protocol.input: one observed initial frame and its uniform periodic spatial grid only
initial_protocol.scale_band: integer modes floor(N/4) <= k < floor(N/2); DC and real Nyquist excluded
initial_protocol.rule: retain coefficients with magnitude >= threshold, always preserve DC; hard threshold only
initial_protocol.retained_modes: data dependent, no fixed physical modes and no family-specific rule
initial_protocol.phase: retained complex coefficients unchanged; irfft handles real Nyquist
initial_protocol.scale_assumption: additive spatial white Gaussian noise; upper-band majority is noise rather than signal
initial_protocol.limitations: single-frame sparse-spectrum prior; broadband signal can bias scale upward and weak physical modes can be removed

candidate_training.candidate_generation: unchanged three fixed weak variants, adaptive L1, normalized OLS debias, fit once
candidate_training.old_controls: unchanged weak_resolved and original-support-anchored fused_median rules
candidate_training.median_generation: training-only; group successful candidate fits by exact term-name set
candidate_training.variant_deduplication: one candidate per fixed variant/support by minimum stable training candidate ID
candidate_training.vector_deduplication: exact equal physical coefficient vectors within support contribute once, retaining all aliases
candidate_training.median: coordinatewise median of distinct physical coefficient vectors, no development filter
candidate_training.median_failure: zero or nonfinite median rejects only the new candidate; no silent term deletion
candidate_training.development_predictor: fixed spectral-hard-filter first frame then resolved factor4
candidate_training.development_selection: within near_factor*best+absolute_tolerance choose fewest terms, error, stable ID
candidate_training.shared_scoring: score augmented denoised pool once, then independently select its original-candidate subset for denoised_weak

prefix_engine_protocol.prefix_prediction: fixed filtered propagation-to-cutoff average followed by full-horizon forecast
prefix_engine_protocol.single_frame_controls: same forecast-start timestamp and complete future horizon; only last prefix observation used

prefix_forecast_protocol.weights: fixed equal per observed prefix frame, no development or final fitting
